# Satyanarayana Pentakoti

> Principal Enterprise Architect for enterprise transformation, AI, data, cloud, and architecture governance.

Satyanarayana Pentakoti is a Principal Enterprise Architect based in Abu Dhabi, UAE. His work focuses on enterprise transformation, technology strategy, business architecture, application and data architecture, GenAI and Agentic AI, enterprise RAG, cloud modernization, platform engineering, architecture governance, security, risk, compliance, and operational resilience.
